description: Tests whether every command in .ai/commands/README.md's registry actually has a complete spec file with all required fields.
pass_condition: Every file in .ai/commands/{name}.md exists and contains all 8 required field headers (as '**Field**:' markdown bold-prefixed lines).
how_to_run: Manually, or via node .ai/scripts/command-lint.mjs once implemented (see Phase 9).
